The three steps had already shipped (v34.28 to v34.30), and the raid screens did not reach 4 with them. The critic now scores all four screens at 2:

| Screen | Before | After v34.30 |
|---|---|---|
| 21 raid hud calm | 2 | 2 |
| 37 extraction countdown | 3 | 2 (the 60% dim hurt it; it is 70% now) |
| 19 first raid | 2 | 2, same as before |
| 61 wheel open | 2 | 2, same as before |

The two best versions are the pictures from before v34.28 (`103-before`) and after v34.30 (`103-final`). They score about the same. Both are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/shots/`.

The critic's remaining findings are bigger than a small ship, and some collide with his rulings:
- **Controls card:** the critic wants it shown only for the first 20 seconds of a raid. His Q70 and F1 orders keep it, so I left it.
- **Top-right column:** the critic wants career and run info as one column with 16 px and larger text. His 10-18 notes fix where that column sits.
- **Panel styles:** the left tag stack and the hint strip use several panel styles, and "scav pistol" shows in three places.
- **Wheel:** the labels sit on top of the icons and there is no scrim behind the wheel.

Those need a fresh design pass with 2 or 3 mockups he picks from. I made no new ship this run.

Step 1 found no capital letter drawn anywhere in the raid HUD. The "I" the critic reported is the small "i" of Barlow Condensed at 1080p; it looks right at 4K.

The notes, including the open findings, are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/103-ui-raid-hud-hierarchy.md`.

Watch on his next play: the belt digits are bigger, and the ammo card fades about 30% during the extraction countdown.

TASK PARTIAL: raid screens still at 2; what remains is the controls card, one top-right column, one panel style and the wheel labels, which need his mockup pick.

NEXT: no further work on this task until he picks a mockup; I move to the next queued task.
